faqs.a:
(a)
Notice and order.
The director shall give written notice to any customer whose uncontrolled cross-connection
               or plumbing system complexity has been found to present a risk to the city's water
               distribution system through an uncontrolled cross-connection.
(1)
Contents of notice and order.
The notice and order shall set forth any order or orders stating the actions necessary
               to control the cross-connection, and allow the customer 14 days from the date of the
               notice and order to comply with each order listed in the notice and order. The notice
               and order shall also remind the customer and property owner of the obligation to control
               the cross-connection on the property, and note that inspection fees, re-inspection
               fees, and other fees, charges, and penalties will be assessed for non-compliance.
               The director may order a customer to take, permit, or allow any action reasonably
               necessary to ensure the connection is in compliance with the provisions of this article,
               including but not limited to ordering that:
(i)
An approved backflow prevention assembly or method be installed or reinstalled at
               each service connection to the premises in a location that provides access for inspection,
               testing, maintenance, and repair, and that testing be done in compliance with this
               article;
(ii)
An assembly or method provide for adequate drainage from the discharge of water from
               reduced pressure principle backflow prevention assemblies, and that such discharge
               shall be conveyed in a manner which does not impact waters of the city or the state;
(iii)
Appropriate winterization actions be undertaken and completed to protect an assembly
               or method from freezing. The director may allow an assembly or method used for seasonal
               services to be removed in lieu of being protected from freezing. Any assembly or method
               removed under this subsection must be tested by a technician upon reinstallation;
               and
(iv)
Where a backflow prevention assembly or method is installed on a water supply system
               using storage water heating equipment such that thermal expansion causes an increase
               in pressure, a device for controlling pressure shall be installed.
(b)
Violation notice.
If a customer fails to comply with the order or orders of the director within 14
               days of the date of the notice and order, the director shall, within 21 days of the
               date of the notice and order, send a violation notice to the customer.
(1)
Contents.
The violation notice shall re-state the order or orders stating the actions necessary
               to control the cross-connection, and may give the customer an additional 14 days from
               the date of the violation notice to comply with the order or orders. The notice shall
               also remind the customer and property owner of the obligation to comply with the order
               or orders of the director, and note that inspection fees, re-inspection fees, and
               other fees, charges, and penalties will continue to be assessed due to non- compliance.
               The notice will inform the customer that a cross-connection inspection fee as set
               forth in the utilities administrative fees and costs schedule will be added to the
               water bill.
(d)
Termination notice.
In the event that the customer does not comply within 42 days of the date of the
               notice and order issued by the director under subsection (a)(1) of this section, or
               within the period of any extension requested by the customer and granted by the director
               under subsection
102-275
(a)(6), whichever date is applicable, the director shall send a notice of termination
               of service to the customer. The termination notice shall also contain a notice that
               a water shut-off, restoration, and other fees and costs as set forth in the utilities
               administrative fees and costs schedule will be assessed against the property as applicable.
               Water service shall be terminated no sooner than seven days after the date of the
               termination notice, and shall remain terminated until such time as the property is
               brought into compliance with the requirements of this article.
(e)
Mailing and posting of notices.
Each notice and order, violation notice, or termination notice issued under this
               section shall be mailed to the customer by first class U.S. Mail. In addition, a termination
               notice shall be posted on the property. In the event that the property owner is different
               than the customer, the notice and order, violation notice, and termination notice
               shall also be mailed to the listed owner, at the address on file with the applicable
               county tax assessor's office. Each notice must state any appeal available. The City's
               inability to comport strictly with the time deadlines set forth herein for the mailing
               or posting of a notice and order, violation notice, or termination notice shall not
               impact the enforcement action.
(f)
Other actions authorized.
Nothing in this section is intended to limit the duties and powers of the director
               as set forth in
sec. 102-275
. The director may, at any time after an uncontrolled cross-connection or other similar
               situation is discovered, and in addition to the actions described in this section,
               take any other action authorized by this article, including issuing a summons and
               complaint.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
